_comment: Update weekly specials. weekOf should be the Monday of the current week.

items.name: Italian Lentil Soup
items.label: Soup of the Day
items.description: A hearty Italian-inspired soup with tender lentils, tomatoes, carrots, celery, and kale, simmered with aromatic herbs in a savory broth.

items.name: Cranberry Walnut Harvest Salad
items.label: Seasonal Salad
items.description: Crisp romaine topped with dried cranberries, toasted walnuts, red onion, and crumbled feta, served with house-made balsamic vinaigrette.

items.name: Chicken Bacon Cheddar Pressed
items.label: Featured Pressed Sandwich
items.description: Tender chicken thigh, crisp bacon, melted sharp cheddar, and maple-pepper mayo on our house bread, pressed golden and crisp.
notes: Served with pickle and Featured Side

items.name: Parmesan Herb Pasta Salad
items.label: Featured Side
items.description: Tender rotini tossed with Parmesan, fresh parsley, Italian herbs, and a light, tangy vinaigrette.

items.name: Glazed Apple Cake
items.label: Sweet Bite of the Day
items.description: Moist, cinnamon-spiced apple cake with raisins and walnuts, finished with a rich, buttery brown sugar glaze.
